question:
(a) State the law of radioactive decay and write the expression for the number of undecayed nuclei after time $t$.
(b) Explain why energy may be released during radioactive decay using the mass-energy relation.

options.A:
(a) Radioactive decay law is $\dfrac{dN}{dt}=+\lambda N$, so $N=N_0e^{\lambda t}$.
(b) Energy is released because product mass is greater than parent mass.
options.B:
(a) Radioactive decay law is $N=N_0-\lambda t$.
(b) Energy release is unrelated to mass difference.
options.C:
(a) $\dfrac{dN}{dt}=-\lambda/N$, so $N=N_0e^{-t/\lambda}$.
(b) Energy is released because all nucleons disappear.
options.D:
(a) The rate of disintegration is proportional to the number present: $\dfrac{dN}{dt}=-\lambda N$, giving $N=N_0e^{-\lambda t}$.
(b) If product mass is less than parent mass, the mass difference is released as energy: $E=\Delta mc^2$.
